summary.question: Performance monitoring shows degraded signal quality on service svc396 (10GE between S13 and S02) from about t=540 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system concluded that the degraded signal quality on svc396 was caused by a dirty connector on the S13–S01 optical multiplex section: CONNECTOR_DIRTY@el:oms.S13-S01(). Confidence is 99.7%. No checks, engineering effort, or site visits were recorded.

template: Cause: CONNECTOR_DIRTY@el:oms.S13-S01() (probability 0.997). Checks made: none. Effort: 0.0 h of tests and travel, 0 site visit(s).
